Serves 8

Ingredients:

1 1/2 pounds of boneless pork shoulder

1/2 pound of lard

2 fresh oranges

6 green serrano chiles

2 large white onions

1 1/2 teaspoons of salt

1/2 teaspoon of sugar

Method:

Trim and wash the pork.  Then marinate the meat in salt, sugar, and juice of two of the oranges for two days.  In a non-stick pan, melt the lard and saute the meat until golden brown. After 15 minutes, use tongs to take out the pork and sear the skin, browning it.  Do this three times.  Cut the remaining two oranges into segments.  Then peel and slice the onions.
